question.:question/problem: Calculate the circulation $Γ$ of the vector field $F(x,y,z)=\left(- y\right)\,i+\left(x\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k$ along the closed curve $C$ given by $r(t)=\left(3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(1 - t^{2}\right)\,k$ for $t\in [-1,1).$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The circulation $Γ$ measures the total work done by a force $F$ in moving a particle along a *closed* curve $C.$
It is given by the formula

$$
Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr=\int_a^b F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$
x=3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)},\quad y=4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)},\quad z=1 - t^{2}.
$$

So,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(- y\right)\,i+\left(x\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k \\ & =\left(- 4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(1 - t^{2}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(- 3 \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 2 t\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(- 4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(- 3 \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 2 t\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(- 4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- 3 \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(3 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot\left(- 2 t\right) \\ & =\left(12 \pi \sin^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(12 \pi \cos^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right) \\ & =12 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr & =\int_{-1}^{1}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{-1}^{1}\left(12 \pi\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[12 \pi t\right]_{-1}^{1} \\ & =[\left(12 \pi\right)]-[\left(- 12 \pi\right)] \\ & =24 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(y\right)\,i+\left(- x\right)\,j+\left(z\right)\,k \\ & =\left(4 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(t^{2}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(4 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(t^{2}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 4 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(2 t\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(4 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(t^{2}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 4 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(2 t\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(4 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- 4 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(t^{2}\right)\cdot\left(2 t\right) \\ & =\left(12 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(12 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(2 t^{3}\right) \\ & =2 t^{3} + 12\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr & =\int_{- \pi}^{\pi}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{- \pi}^{\pi}\left(2 t^{3} + 12\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[\frac{t^{4}}{2} + 12 t\right]_{- \pi}^{\pi} \\ & =[\left(12 \pi\right)+\left(\frac{\pi^{4}}{2}\right)]-[\left(- 12 \pi\right)+\left(\frac{\pi^{4}}{2}\right)] \\ & =24 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$

$$

So,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(0\right)\,i+\left(z\right)\,j+\left(- y\right)\,k \\ & =\left(0\right)\,i+\left(4 \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(t^{2} - t\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(3 \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(4 \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(2 t - 1\right)\,i+\left(- 6 \pi \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(8 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(0\right)\,i+\left(4 \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(2 t - 1\right)\,i+\left(- 6 \pi \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(8 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(0\right)\cdot\left(2 t - 1\right)+\left(4 \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- 6 \pi \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(8 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =\left(0\right)+\left(- 24 \pi \sin^{2}{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)+\left(- 24 \pi \cos^{2}{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =- 24 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr & =\int_{0}^{1}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{0}^{1}\left(- 24 \pi\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[- 24 \pi t\right]_{0}^{1} \\ & =[\left(- 24 \pi\right)]-[\left(0\right)] \\ & =- 24 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$

So,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(- 2 x + 5 y\right)\,i+\left(0\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k \\ & =\left(10 t^{3} - 10 t^{2}\right)\,i+\left(0\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(5 t^{2} - 5 t\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(2 t^{3} - 2 t\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(10 t - 5\right)\,i+\left(6 t^{2} - 2\right)\,j+\left(2 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(10 t^{3} - 10 t^{2}\right)\,i+\left(0\right)\,j+\left(0\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(10 t - 5\right)\,i+\left(6 t^{2} - 2\right)\,j+\left(2 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(10 t^{3} - 10 t^{2}\right)\cdot\left(10 t - 5\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot\left(6 t^{2} - 2\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot\left(2 \pi \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =\left(100 t^{4} - 150 t^{3} + 50 t^{2}\right)+\left(0\right)+\left(0\right) \\ & =\left(10 t - 5\right) \left(10 t^{3} - 10 t^{2}\right)\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr & =\int_{0}^{1}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{0}^{1}\left(\left(10 t - 5\right) \left(10 t^{3} - 10 t^{2}\right)\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[20 t^{5} - \frac{75 t^{4}}{2} + \frac{50 t^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{1} \\ & =[\left(\frac{50}{3}\right)+\left(- \frac{75}{2}\right)+\left(20\right)]-[\left(0\right)+\left(0\right)+\left(0\right)] \\ & =- \frac{5}{6}\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(3 - 3 t^{2}\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(3 t^{2}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(- 6 t\right)\,i+\left(6 t\right)\,j+\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(3\right)\,i+\left(0\right)\,j+\left(- 4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(- 6 t\right)\,i+\left(6 t\right)\,j+\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(3\right)\cdot\left(- 6 t\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot\left(6 t\right)+\left(- 4 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(4 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =\left(- 18 t\right)+\left(0\right)+\left(- 16 \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)} \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =- 18 t - 8 \pi \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}Γ=\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr & =\int_{-1}^{1}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{-1}^{1}\left(- 18 t - 8 \pi \sin{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[- 9 t^{2} + 4 \cos{\left(2 \pi t \right)}\right]_{-1}^{1} \\ & =[\left(-9\right)+\left(4\right)]-[\left(-9\right)+\left(4\right)] \\ & =0\end{aligned}
